description: Recompute the Kabsch/TM-score superposition of the mug151 core onto experimental SAP30BP, and plot it alongside the domain-architecture divergence and the STRING-versus-BioGRID evidence provenance
code:
import os, json, requests
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}

# ---- inputs: reuse persistent provenance copies, else re-fetch ----
def read_or_fetch(path, url, filt=None):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        txt=open(path).read()
    else:
        txt=requests.get(url, headers=H, timeout=120).text
    return txt

af_txt = read_or_fetch("provenance/mug151_core_31_131.pdb",
                       "https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q10069-F1-model_v6.pdb")
af_core = {}
for l in af_txt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        r=int(l[22:26])
        if 31<=r<=131: af_core[r]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])

ex_txt = read_or_fetch("provenance/9QKZ_chainA_SAP30BP.pdb",
                       "https://files.rcsb.org/download/9QKZ.pdb")
ex={}
for l in ex_txt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA' and l[21]=='A':
        ex[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])

# ---- alignment from the reciprocal Foldseek run (query=9QKZ_A, target=mug151) ----
qAln="SFSERVRNMSPD--------EIKIPPEPPGRCSNHLQDKIQKLYERKIKEGMDMNYIIQRKKEFRNPSIYEKLIQFCAI-DELGTNYPKDMFDPHGWSEDSYYEALAKAQKIEMDKLEKA"
tAln="EEQTSLVNENNDIKGRSEEPHWKIPNSPKAEVDTELEKKIKQFIKLKA-KGIHFHTRLSENENFRNPKLLDNLQDFLDIKEPRGTMISKDMWDPTDFHKNVYASALSKSQDEMIARRENY"
qi,ti,off=7,11,97
pairs=[]
for a,b in zip(qAln,tAln):
    if a!='-' and b!='-':
        qr, tr = off+qi+1, ti+1
        if qr in ex and tr in af_core: pairs.append((qr,tr,a,b))
    if a!='-': qi+=1
    if b!='-': ti+=1
print("aligned CA pairs usable:", len(pairs))

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))
    D=np.diag([1,1,d]); R=V@D@Wt
    return Pc@R, Qc

P=np.array([ex[p[0]] for p in pairs]); Q=np.array([af_core[p[1]] for p in pairs])

# iterative trimming curve
cur=list(range(len(pairs))); curve=[]
for _ in range(40):
    A,B=kabsch(P[cur],Q[cur])
    d=np.linalg.norm(A-B,axis=1)
    curve.append((len(cur), float(np.sqrt((d**2).mean()))))
    if len(cur)<=20: break
    keep=np.argsort(d)[:max(20,int(len(cur)*0.93))]
    cur=[cur[i] for i in keep]
curve=np.array(curve)

# TM-score on the full-pair superposition, both normalisations
A,B=kabsch(P,Q); d=np.linalg.norm(A-B,axis=1)
def tm(d,L):
    d0=1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8
    return float(np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L)
tm_h, tm_p = tm(d,118), tm(d,101)
print(f"all-pairs RMSD {np.sqrt((d**2).mean()):.2f} A ; TM(118)={tm_h:.3f} TM(101)={tm_p:.3f}")
for n,r in curve[:1]: pass
sel=[c for c in curve if c[0] in (110,80,58)]
print("trim curve sample:", curve[:3], "...", curve[-3:])

# ---- panel data: domain architecture ----
arch={'Human SAP30BP (Q9UHR5, 308 aa)':dict(L=308,pf=(118,215),ulm=(252,257)),
      'S. pombe mug151 (Q10069, 146 aa)':dict(L=146,pf=(34,127),ulm=None)}

# ---- panel data: evidence provenance ----
edges=[('cdk11',0.696,0.684),('lcp1',0.611,0.611),('tho1',0.777,0.761),
       ('sap62',0.535,0.498),('wdr83',0.469,0.451),('prp2',0.459,0.451)]
biogrid=[('par1','positive'),('wdr7','positive'),('rsv2','negative'),
         ('prp22','negative'),('xap5','negative')]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(curve[:,0],curve[:,1],'o-',color='#1f77b4',ms=4)
for n,r in curve:
    if int(n) in (110,80,58):
        ax.annotate(f"{int(n)} pairs\n{r:.2f} A",(n,r),textcoords="offset points",
                    xytext=(6,8),fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(2.0,ls=':',c='grey'); ax.invert_xaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("CA pairs retained after trimming"); ax.set_ylabel("RMSD (A)")
ax.set_title(f"A. Kabsch fit, mug151 core vs 9QKZ chain A\nTM-score {tm_h:.3f} (norm 118) / {tm_p:.3f} (norm 101)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
for i,(name,d_) in enumerate(arch.items()):
    y=1-i
    ax.barh(y,d_['L'],height=0.32,color='#dddddd',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
    s,e=d_['pf']; ax.barh(y,e-s,left=s,height=0.32,color='#4c72b0',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
    ax.text(s+(e-s)/2,y,"PF07818",ha='center',va='center',color='w',fontsize=8)
    if d_['ulm']:
        s2,e2=d_['ulm']; ax.barh(y,max(e2-s2,4),left=s2,height=0.32,color='#c44e52',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
        ax.annotate("ULM KRKSKW\n(binds RBM17 UHM)",(e2,y),textcoords="offset points",
                    xytext=(4,-22),fontsize=8,color='#c44e52')
    else:
        ax.annotate("no ULM, no Trp in C-tail;\nno RBM17 ortholog in S. pombe",(d_['L'],y),
                    textcoords="offset points",xytext=(6,-6),fontsize=8,color='#555555')
    ax.text(-6,y,name,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-130,420); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,1.6); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_title("B. Domain architecture: only the PF07818 core is shared",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[2]
names=[e[0] for e in edges]
ax.barh(range(len(edges)),[e[2] for e in edges],color='#8172b2',edgecolor='k',linewidth=.6)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(edges))); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("STRING experiments-channel score")
ax.set_xlim(0,1.0)
for i,e in enumerate(edges):
    ax.text(e[2]+0.015,i,"no S. pombe physical record",va='center',fontsize=7.5,color='#8172b2')
ax.set_title("C. STRING edges with zero database and zero text support\n"
             "BioGRID for mug151: 5 genetic interactions only\n"
             "(prp22 and xap5 are splicing factors)",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

json.dump({"n_pairs":len(pairs),"tm_norm118":tm_h,"tm_norm101":tm_p,
           "trim_curve":curve.tolist(),"string_edges":edges,"biogrid":biogrid},
          open("provenance/iter2_superposition_and_evidence_provenance.json","w"),indent=1)
print("saved provenance/iter2_superposition_and_evidence_provenance.json")
